sahneler.metin: At night, a passenger ship caught fire while docked in Toronto Harbour.
It spread in minutes, and at least one hundred eighteen people died.
Smoke came from a locked linen closet.
A bellboy ran for the keys without sounding the alarm.
When the closet was opened, fire burst into the hallway.
Polished wood paneling fed the flames.
Fire rules for passenger ships were tightened.

aciklama:
Noronic burned at its pier in Toronto Harbour. The cause: a delayed alarm and polished wood paneling letting fire spread through the ship.

#shorts #engineering #firesafety
